verdict.rationale: ByteAsk's own docs say the agent 'reads your codebase' on its own, which suggests autonomous context gathering. Nothing documents mapping or explaining an entire unfamiliar codebase. Missing for 10: documented whole-repo mapping or indexing, codebase explanation or summarization output, explicit automatic context selection without manual file picking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files

citations.quote: ByteAsk opens a full-screen TUI, reads your codebase, edits files, compiles, runs tests
